Rearranged Protocol field ordering and updated protocol explanation

Added private chat functionality, changed public/private protocol

When clicking on a user on the right, a new tab now opens for chatting
directly to that user. The client checks what tab is active before
sending a message and uses SERVER or the tab name in the appropriate
point in the messaging protocol to the server. Server also now handles
as appropriate with new protocol.

ChatFlow class changed to ChatFlowTab and now extends Tab instead of
ScrollPane (contains a ScrollPane as its content).

Added SERVER as a constant in Protocol.

Fixed IndexOutOfBoundsException on server when users exited; USER_EXIT
now is distinct in the switch from MESSAGE and ACTION

Refactored TextFlow and its ScrollPane into separate class

In preparation for adding private messaging, the ChatFlow class has been
created. This will allow for a new tab with identical
ScrollPane/TextFlow layouts for each private message as well as for the
main chat area.

Added user panel

User panel shows all logged in users, including "me", in the color in
which that that user's text will display.
Currently clicking on the user will simply print a message to the
console.

Disallowed Protocol.DELIM in client>server messages.

If used attempts to send a message that includes the delimiter, a
message will be displayed indicating that the delimiter string is not
allowed to be included in their messages.

removed synchronised keyword, fixed action formatting.

I believe I was using the synchronised keyword incorrectly so I have
removed it for now. I'll read up on how to use it correctly and add it
back in if appropriate.

Actions were formatted on the sender as "Me: /me does whatever" and on
the receiver as "User /me does whatever"
